title: Evals & Rubrics for AI PMs
subtitle: Build rigorous evaluation frameworks for AI products and ace your PM interviews

modules.title: What Evals Are and Why They Matter
modules.description: Learn the fundamental mental models for AI product evaluation, why traditional QA doesn't work for LLMs, and how evals tie to product quality and user trust.

topics.title: Why Traditional QA Fails for AI Products
The Taxonomy of Evals: Unit, Integration, Regression, and Adversarial
When to Run Evals: Development, Pre-Release, and Production Monitoring
Coverage Strategy: Happy Paths, Edge Cases, and Failure Modes

modules.title: Designing Rubrics That Work
modules.description: Master the art of writing concrete scoring criteria, from binary pass/fail to nuanced multi-dimensional rubrics that capture what good looks like.

topics.title: Anatomy of a Good Rubric: Criteria, Scales, and Examples
Choosing Rubric Dimensions: Accuracy, Helpfulness, Safety, Tone
Binary vs. Likert vs. Custom Scales: When to Use Each
Real Rubric Examples: Customer Support, Code Generation, Summarization

modules.title: Building and Running Eval Workflows
modules.description: Go from theory to practice: assemble eval datasets, choose human vs. LLM-as-judge, interpret results, and integrate evals into your product development cycle.

topics.title: Creating Eval Datasets: Sourcing, Labeling, and Versioning
Human Graders vs. LLM-as-Judge: Trade-offs and When to Use Each
Reading Eval Results: Aggregate Scores, Distributions, and Regressions
Communicating Evals in Interviews: Frameworks and Examples
